title: apps/auth-service authentication.service.ts has 8 getRepository() calls — cross-tenant risk in auth path
rule_violated: CLAUDE.md "getRepository() is FORBIDDEN → use getScopedRepository()" — auth is MEDIUM here because auth.tenants is intentionally cross-tenant (login resolves tenant); but every NON-tenant-resolver callsite must scope.
notes: Tier 1: same eslint ban as HIGH-002/003/008, plus per-callsite review to distinguish legit cross-tenant resolver calls from bypasses.
